entry.title: Welcome to my personal website
entry.content:
I am a physicist and engineer, specialized in particle physics.

This website is a gathering of personnal information. You may find my CV, a list of publications, and some of my projects.

Keywords: Symbolic computation, Python, Mathematica, High Energy Physics, Flavor Physics, Optimization, Data Analysis, Monte-Carlo Methods, SAT-MILP solvers.
